Teja wants to reveal about his sufferings to Amma but other wants to stop him. Although, after several attempts by Bhanu, Shanti and others; Teja chooses to narrate the complete story to Amma that he had an encounter with Lion on his way. But luckily it is the noisy train, due to which Amma is unable to hear anything! Want to know what happened next? Then stay tuned in and find out here!
